description: Reusable HyperFrames overlay elements for automated reel video production. All elements are 9:16 vertical (1080x1920), horror black-and-white CRT style. Pick one randomly per video type to add variety.

elements.description: SMPTE film-leader style countdown. Shows 3, 2, 1 inside a circle with tick marks. Each digit flashes in with a white frame, then cuts to black. Film scratches and global flicker.
VHS static countdown. Digits 3, 2, 1 glitch in with rapid horizontal jitter, chromatic shadow offset, and a sweeping TV scan line. Tracking-line artifacts between digits.
Horizontal progress bar fills left to right with a glowing white lead edge and live percentage counter. Typewriter 'LOADING' label. Fades out cleanly when full.
SVG ring fills 0–360° with a white orbital dot tracking the leading edge. Percentage counter in the center. 'LOADING' label below. Fades out cleanly when full.
12 rectangular segments fill left to right with a staggered glow. Counter shows 'N / 12' as segments activate. Pulse sweep at end before clean fade.
Gothic medieval lower third. UnifrakturMaguntia blackletter headline slides in from left with letter-spacing collapse. Rule line draws before text. Special Elite subtitle fades up.
Typewriter reveal lower third. Special Elite text clips in character by character with steps() easing. Blinking pipe cursor. Rule line draws via steps. CRT power-on flash at entry.
Rubber stamp impact lower third. Bebas Neue headline scales down hard from 1.55× with a white flash on impact. Rule line slams in. Subtitle drops from above.
Impact slam countdown. Digits 3, 2, 1 slam down from above with hard scale-down impact and white flash. More urgent and physical than pulse/glitch.
Handwritten manuscript lower third. Caveat font draws on-screen as if written by hand. Sketchy rule line. Casual, intimate, personal feel.
Worn/distressed lower third. Text appears with texture overlay simulating aged paper, scratches, fading. Archive-document feel.

usage.random_countdown: Pick a random element where type == 'countdown'
usage.random_loader: Pick a random element where type == 'loader'
usage.random_lower_third: Pick a random element where type == 'lower-third'. Replace placeholder.main with subject name and placeholder.sub with context text.
usage.render_all: Loop elements[], run render_cmd for each
usage.customize_lower_third: Edit the HTML to replace 'The Witness' / 'THE WITNESS' with the subject name and 'Disappeared · 1987' / 'DISAPPEARED · 1987' with the context line before rendering.
usage.add_text_overlay: To add custom text (title, CTA, caption) on top of an element, create a sub-composition that references the element's path and adds your text layer above it.
usage.note: These are pure animation elements — no end text, no branding. Add copy per-video.
